facts.claim: The American Marathi mission was founded in Bombay in 1813 by Gordon Hall and Samuel Nott.
facts.quote: The American Marathi mission waK founded in Bombay in 1813 by the Revd. Gordon Hall and the Revd. Samuel Nott, who had been expelled from Calcutta by the East India Company.

facts.claim: The American Mission organized a Church Sunday school that is attended by 750 pupils.
facts.quote: The American Mission has org'anized a Church Sunday school, attended by 750 pupils ; a Christian En- deavour Society which preaches, distributes tracts and visits hospitals ; a Poor Fund ; and a missionary branch at Lalitpur, Central India.

facts.claim: The total number of the Christian community of the church is 631.
